entry.title: NLRB Appoints Five New Administrative Law Judges
entry.summary:
September 08, 2026
The National Labor Relations Board (NLRB) has appointed five new Administrative Law Judges (ALJs): David Goldman, Lisa Dunn, Stephanie Cotilla Eitzen, Zuzana Murarova, and Steven Wyllie.  They were chosen after a rigorous vetting process. entry.title: Despite Hurdles, Board and General Counsel Report Favorable Case Processing Data for FY 2026, but Emphasize there is More Work to be Done
entry.summary:
October 30, 2026
Newly released case processing data confirms that the National Labor Relations Board successfully reduced a substantial inherited backlog during FY 2026 while continuing to see a significant demand for its services. In Fiscal Year (FY) 2026 (October 1, 2025, to September 30, 2026), 21,587 Charges and Petitions were filed with the Agency, a slight decrease of 4.27% over FY 2025. entry.title: Amy L. Cocuzza Named Solicitor to the National Labor Relations Board
entry.summary:
November 02, 2026
The National Labor Relations Board (NLRB) today announced the appointment of Amy L. Cocuzza as the new Solicitor. Ms. Cocuzza is now the chief legal advisor and consultant to the entire Board on all questions of law regarding the Board’s general operations and on major questions of law and policy concerning the adjudication of NLRB cases in the Courts of Appeals and the U.S. Supreme Court.
